name: @credda/cli
description: Official Credda CLI — look up and offline-verify portable trust from the terminal: public trust checks, credential verification, platform score reads, share-token minting. A thin client over @credda/js; no scoring logic lives here.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm')){console.error('
  Refusing to publish with npm.

  This package depends on @credda/js via workspace:*. pnpm rewrites
  that to a real version range while packing; npm ships it verbatim,
  and every consumer install then fails with:

    npm error Unsupported URL Type \"workspace:\"

  Use: pnpm publish --filter <name>
');process.exit(1)}"
